'''Gungan catapults''', also called '''gungan energy catapults''' or '''whizboomas''', were mobile weapons that were used by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends]] against invading [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The catapults launched large [[Booma/Legends|boomas]] that deactivated the enemy droids. The catapult was made of [[hornweed]].
